title: Artefact Present — payload
description: An artefact forged or witnessed in the spellweb ceremony (kind spellweb/artefact/1): the blade, its proof as the ceremony produced it, and optionally the constellation node ids it was evoked from. The response ($defs.Response) carries the verifier's checks.

kind.description: The artefact kind. Only spellweb/artefact/1 is defined by this version.

artefact.description: The blade as the ceremony named it.

id.description: spellweb's local identifier for the blade (`blade-<epoch ms>`). Unique per bearer, not globally.

emoji.description: The blade's emoji glyph as forged.

tier.description: The blade's tier, from the charge reached at the evoke.

stratum.description: The Hamming weight of the blade's six dimensions, 0 to 6.

forgedAt.description: When the blade was forged, as the bearer's clock read it.

witness.description: Present only on a witness blade: what it witnessed. Absent means the bearer forged the blade from their own constellation.

of.description: The witnessed constellation's hash; null when the source did not carry one.

from.description: Where the witnessed artefact came from (its file or bearer label); null when unknown.

proof.description: The proof exactly as the ceremony produced it. A recomputed value will not re-derive.

constellationHash.description: spellweb's hashConstellation over the ordered node ids.

bladeHash.description: The blade's hash, binding it to its predecessor.

previousBladeHash.description: The bearer's previous blade's bladeHash; null exactly when this is the bearer's first blade (chainLength 1).

chainLength.description: The blade's position on the bearer's chain, from 1.

commitment.description: sha256(constellationHash + nonce), made before the evoke. The nonce is not carried; a verifier given it out of band can open the commitment.

commitmentVerified.description: Whether spellweb opened its own commitment at forge time. A producer statement; a verifier without the nonce reports it as not re-derived.

signature.description: spellweb's signature over the blade, as hex or base64url. It also names the document (`urn:spellweb:artefact:<signature>`).

chargeLevel.description: The charge reached by the trace before the evoke.

lapCount.description: How many laps of the constellation the bearer traced before the evoke.

nodeCount.description: How many nodes the constellation holds.

bladeHex.description: OPTIONAL. The blade's display colour as hex, cosmetic only.

deviationHash.description: OPTIONAL. Hash of the trace's deviation from the canonical path, where spellweb recorded one.

mage.description: OPTIONAL. The Mage half's co-signature where the bearer's dual key held one. Absent means the Swordsman forged alone.

id.description: The Mage participant id from the bearer's City Key.

constellation.description: OPTIONAL. The ordered knowledge-graph node ids the bearer traced and evoked. Absent means the bearer withholds the path and the constellation check is not performed.

Check.description: One check's result: true passed, false failed, `notReDerived` when the verifier lacked the input to re-derive it, `notPerformed` when the input was absent.

Response.description: The verifier's determination. A failed check is a successful verification with ok: false, not an error.

ok.description: True when every check performed passed.

checks.description: Each check of the Verification section by name.
